blocks.heading: What our customers say about us
Frequently asked questions
blocks.description: We answer the most common questions before starting a partnership. If you have any additional questions, please contact us.

items.question: How long does it take to see the first effects of an advertising campaign?
items.answer: Typically, the first results are visible within 2–3 weeks of launching a campaign. However, optimization takes longer – the full picture of effectiveness is usually visible after 6–8 weeks.

items.question: Can I scale sales without increasing my advertising budget?
items.answer: Yes – up to a point. First, we squeeze out what the current budget can give: better creatives, tighter targeting and a cleaner funnel. When those margins run out, growth needs more budget.

items.question: What do you do if a campaign doesn't produce the expected results?
items.answer: We look for the reason in the data instead of adding budget: creative, audience, offer or the store itself. Then we change one thing at a time, so we know what actually moved the numbers.

items.question: Can I run Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns simultaneously?
items.answer: Yes, and in most stores that is exactly what we recommend. The two channels play different roles – Google collects existing demand, Meta creates it – so we measure them together, not against each other.

items.question: How do you measure the success of a campaign?
items.answer: By revenue and margin, not by clicks. You get one dashboard with the goal, revenue, orders and ad cost for both channels, so the result is a number you can check yourself at any time.

items.question: Do you also deal with website optimization?
items.answer: We handle everything that stands between the ad and the order: analytics, product pages and checkout. We point out what is worth changing and we implement it in your Shopify store together with you.
